NT5E.Title: Negotiation
NT5E.ResetConfirm: Clear the tracker and start over?
NT5E.GMOnly: Only the GM can open the negotiation tracker.
NT5E.NoActor: Choose a character who makes the roll.
NT5E.PickPitfall: Pick a pitfall in the "Appeals to" list first.
NT5E.ReadLocked: You can't read this NPC again until someone makes an argument.
NT5E.SetupHint: Mark Motivations (left square) and Pitfalls (right square) for the NPC first. The Director may adjust the starting numbers with the ladders below.
NT5E.OnceHint: A Motivation can be successfully appealed to only once.
NT5E.Neither: Neither a Motivation nor a Pitfall
NT5E.RoleplayHint: Counts as a great success without a roll
NT5E.ReadHint: You can't read the NPC again until someone makes an argument.
NT5E.FinalNote: This is the NPC's final offer.
NT5E.EndedNote: Interest 0: the NPC offers nothing and ends the talks.

OfferText.0: The NPC offers nothing, refuses to talk further and may seek to harm the heroes.
OfferText.1: The NPC flatly refuses, with no counteroffer.
OfferText.2: The NPC can't give what was asked, but offers something lesser in exchange.
OfferText.3: The NPC agrees to the deal but asks for a little extra (a favor or payment).
OfferText.4: The NPC gives everything asked for and accepts what the heroes offered.
OfferText.5: The NPC gives everything and sweetens the deal (or waives the heroes' obligations).

Note.repeat: This Motivation was already appealed to.
Note.caughtLie: The NPC caught the lie: −1 Interest on top of the result.
Note.readAnnoyed: Nothing learned, and the NPC is annoyed.
Note.readHard: The NPC is hard to read.
Note.readLearn: Learn one Motivation or Pitfall (player's choice).

dcSuccess.name: Success DC
dcSuccess.hint: Result at or above this counts as a success (draw-steel tier 2). Default 10.

dcGreat.name: Great success DC
dcGreat.hint: Result at or above this counts as a great success (draw-steel tier 3). Default 15.

publicChat.name: Post results publicly
publicChat.hint: If off, chat messages are whispered to the GM only.

NT5E.ArgText: What the hero says (shown to players)
NT5E.NoActorPlayer: Select your token or assign a character to your user to roll.
NT5E.NoActiveGM: No GM is online to record the result.
NT5E.RemoveConvConfirm: Delete this conversation with all its NPCs and log?
NT5E.AddNpc: Add an NPC to this conversation
NT5E.RemoveNpcConfirm: Remove this NPC from the conversation?
NT5E.TargetsHint: One roll hits every checked NPC. Each is resolved separately by their own Motivations and Pitfalls.
NT5E.NoTargets: Tick at least one active NPC.
